policy: Behaviour end-to-end over real archives. No mocks, no fakes, no synthesised DEX. Ground truth is either the DEX bytecode (bench/disas.py) or the Python reference implementation -- never rasc's own output. A scenario is declared here before the code that satisfies it is written.

fixture.provenance: small single-DEX APK used for the first full-archive scans (6,220 classes); not shipped with the repo

scenarios.title: a short-circuit guard chain keeps every branch body (|| / && must not lose code)
scenarios.note: ground truth: reference + bytecode (hasCategory(LAUNCHER) and hasCategory(LEANBACK_LAUNCHER) each guarded by if-eqz, both calling apply()). Before fork 5f1873b the else branch rendered as `if (v3_13) { }` -- the second apply() was gone. rasc may express the chain as nested ifs instead of one `||`: semantics, not shape, is what this scenario pins.

scenarios.title: invoke-direct/range arguments beyond five registers survive (no dropped `""`)
scenarios.note: decode.rs used to truncate the register list of invoke-*/range at five, so the trailing empty string argument disappeared (546 method bodies in this class). Ground truth: reference + bytecode. The two remaining empty control bodies were inspected by hand: both are the empty `else` the reference prints as well.

scenarios.title: an enum whose $VALUES is inlined still renders a coherent class
require_stdout_regex: private Syntax\(String v1, int v2, int v3\)
scenarios.note: ground truth: bytecode (the constructor takes (String name, int ordinal, int value) and calls super(name, ordinal); $VALUES, values(), valueOf(String) exist; R8 builds $VALUES inline instead of calling $values(), verified by instruction scan of classes10.dex). Before fork 43b79e8 this shape rendered a parameterless constructor next to argument-carrying `new Syntax("SYNTAX_PROTO2", ...)` calls, i.e. uncompilable Java, with values()/valueOf()/$VALUES suppressed. The pinned instance moved here from the saripaar enum on the retired xiaomi-router corpus.

scenarios.title: shared-region reuse cannot explode the output
scenarios.note: ground truth: measured. With unbounded region reuse this class produced 2,268,053,229 bytes in 102.6 s (a shared region copied into a path that already contained a copy); with the 4,096-statement / 65,536-copy budget (fork 963f15d) it is 820,884 bytes in ~0.1-0.5 s. The scenario is a growth gate, not a size assertion.

scenarios.title: new-instance + invoke-direct <init> stay one expression, even through a receiver copy
require_stdout_regex: (?s)MvvmList v([0-9_]+) = new com\.tencent\.mm\.plugin\.mvvmlist\.MvvmList\(v2, v3, v10, null, null, 24, null\);.*?this\.mvvmList = v\1;
scenarios.note: ground truth: bytecode. In <init> the receiver of a seven-register invoke-direct/range <init> is a move-object copy of the new-instance register (found by instruction scan, classes.dex), so the instance stored in this.mvvmList is the one constructed with arguments. Until the vendored droidsaw-dex fix the look-ahead matched only the 35c `invoke-direct`, never `invoke-direct/range`, so the pair rendered as a bare `new MvvmList()` bound to the variable plus a discarded `new MvvmList(args)` statement -- invalid Java and an unconstructed object. The require pattern ties the constructed variable to the one stored, so a regression that only renames or reorders cannot pass. The previous pin (Lcom/xiaomi/push/r3; on the xiaomi-router APK) retired with that corpus; wechat alone has 10,329 classes with this shape.

scenarios.title: a guard chain that shares one body keeps its literal and its call
scenarios.note: ground truth: reference + bytecode. The method-set signal is tolerated here and is a harness artefact: the reference inlines `new StringBuilder().append(..).toString()`, rasc uses `+` concatenation, so the library call names differ while the string literal -- the semantic anchor -- is present in both.

scenarios.title: CLI contracts hold on a device APK
scenarios.note: bench/contracts.sh: dotted == slashed descriptors, --threads determinism, -o equals stdout, SIGPIPE exits without panic, --debug only on stderr, missing class exits 1 with 'not found'.

scenarios.title: CLI contracts hold on a second device APK
CLI contracts hold on a system framework jar
per-class quality over a device corpus stays within budget
scenarios.note: 1300 sampled classes; measured 261 flagged (20.08%). Threshold has headroom; 0 errors is absolute.

scenarios.title: per-class quality over a second device corpus stays within budget
per-class quality over a system framework jar stays within budget
no mocking framework or fake is used anywhere in the repo
scenarios.note: executable form of the testing policy in AGENTS.md: every suite drives the real binary over real archives, so a mocking/faking import or helper anywhere is a policy violation, not a style choice. The needles are usage-shaped on purpose -- prose in the policy documents and in this runner may name them without violating anything.

scenarios.title: `rasc cfg` matches the reference control-flow graph
acceptance_criteria: `rasc cfg <corpus> <dalvik-class> <method>` exits 0 for every method that has code, and 1 with a 'not found' message for a missing class/method
block set and successor sets equal the reference's for the pinned methods (ground truth: reference on dev-0.1.0 droidasc/cli.py cfg, backed by bytecode branch offsets)
--format dot output parses as a directed graph with one node per block; --format json is valid JSON with the same node/edge counts
scenarios.note: criteria declared before implementation, per the testing policy. The reference implementation is droidasc/asc_core/analysis/cfg.py (447 lines) on dev-0.1.0.

scenarios.title: `summary` / `aidl` / `receivers` on the rust branch match the reference
acceptance_criteria: summary: byte-identical to the reference for the pinned class list, including the trailing blank line
aidl: same interface set on services.jar (83 interfaces), same transaction-code values, byte-identical modulo line order
receivers: same declared/dynamic/verified classification; the report matches the reference modulo ordering
all three exit 0 and honour -o (file bytes == stdout bytes)
scenarios.note: the implementations exist on wip/summary-aidl-receivers (583fcba) and are not merged into rust yet; the scenarios are declared first so the merge is judged against them rather than against 'tests pass'.
